items.title: 5.13.2 Rozmarra zindagi mein liquid crystals ke istemal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.13.2, printed pages 112-113, with Quick Check 5.9 and answers.

blocks.text: Liquid crystals ka sab se bara istemal electro-optic devices mein hai: yeh bijli se control hone wale aalaat hain jo roshni ko apni marzi ke mutabiq badalte (modulate karte) hain. Rozmarra zindagi mein liquid crystals ke bohat se istemal hain.

Khas liquid crystal devices se jism mein tumours aur infections ka pata lagaya ja sakta hai, kyunke tumour jaise masail ka temperature aas paas ke tissue se aksar mukhtalif hota hai. Cholesteric liquid crystals chhati (breast) par lagane se tumour baqi hisson se garam hone ki wajah se nazar aa jata hai. Is tareeqe se breast cancer ki ibtidai stage mein kamyabi se tashkhees hoti hai.
ii) Zyada temperature wali jagah dhoondna
Liquid crystal temperature sensors circuit board par kharab connections ko un ke zyada temperature se dhoond lete hain. Temperature sensors ke taur par yeh thermometers mein bhi istemal hote hain.

Liquid crystal technology ka sab se aam istemal LCDs hain. Oscillograph, TV, laptops aur mobile phones ki screens is ki misalein hain. TV displays, computer screens, calculators aur gharion (watches) mein bhi liquid crystals lagte hain.
Jaise jaise liquid crystals ki nayi properties aur qismein dhoondi aur parhi ja rahi hain, sanat (industry) aur science mein in ki ahmiyat barhti jayegi.

blocks.prompt: a) Liquid crystals kin properties mein solids jaise hain?
blocks.explanation: Parallel ba-tarteeb tarteeb, crystal jaisi optical properties, kuch had tak sakhti (rigidity) aur anisotropy.

blocks.prompt: b) Liquid crystals kin properties mein liquids jaise hain?
blocks.explanation: Woh liquids ki tarah behte (flow karte) hain aur viscosity dikhate hain; un ke molecules fluid mein idhar udhar ja sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Liquid crystals ki kaun si property unhen temperature naapne wale aalaat mein kaam ka banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Un ki optical properties (rang aur roshni guzarne ka andaz) temperature ke saath badalti hain. Is liye garam jagah, jaise tumour ya kharab connection, rang ki tabdeeli se nazar aa jati hai.

items: Istemal: tumours aur infections ki tashkhees (cholesteric liquid crystals, garam jagah), circuit board ke kharab connections aur thermometers, aur LCD screens (TV, laptop, phone, calculator, ghari).
